title: THE RENDER WEEK · The dog is a placeholder
venue: Arthur's site · a science-fiction week the papers declined · posted once, taken down
logline: Wednesday: the dog renders as a gray box for three panels — a placeholder with a label the strip draws as a shape — while everything around him is finished, and Wood puts a hand on the box where the dog's back would be. The fourth panel the dog is the dog. The hand hasn't moved.
